SmartAuth._comment: DevMode enables the Development-only login (any username, password Password123!). It is honoured only on a Development host. A username gets a SMART token only once it is bound to a member or provider; see docs/security/smart-auth-tenancy.md.

ChoAuth._comment: Development-only trust for the admin API and POST /launch. Symmetric keys are refused on any host other than Development/Testing. Deployed environments configure asymmetric keys from Key Vault (see docs/security/portal-token-service.md).
